title: A Choir for the Spire Revisited
author: Silas Eriksen
blurb: Odile Oyelaran, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
